svg.title: Network Architecture - Governed Agentic Security on GKE
svg.desc: Network view of the lab. Supply chain and telemetry sit outside the cluster. GKE namespaces split detect/analyze on the left from govern/execute on the right. GCP supporting services sit on a side rail. Fail-closed by default.
svg.text: Agentic AI — Governed Multi-Agent Security Platform

text.tspan: Governed agentic security on GKE. Left side detects and reasons.
Right side authorizes and acts. Fail-closed; Gemini never authorizes.

g.text: GitHub Actions OIDC / WIF - signed digests only
Falco is Helm namespace falco / Trivy and Prowler run in namespace security / Logging and SCC are GCP
namespaces are isolation boundaries / Pub/Sub topics are the only hop between agents
joins weak signals with Firestore state
Vertex is a reasoning tool, not a control plane
Platform guardrails: NetworkPolicy / RBAC / Workload Identity / HPA / PDB / PodMonitoring / Policy Controller

text.tspan: Agents do not call these to authorize.
